test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct direct narration of the given sentence.

They said that they would go the next day.

options.text: They said, “I will have went tomorrow.”
They said, “We will be go tomorrow.”

solution:
The correct answer is “**We will go tomorrow.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original statement uses "they" as the subject pronoun, indicating a third-person plural perspective. When converting the statement to direct speech, it's necessary to change the pronoun to match the speakers' perspective. Therefore, "they" becomes "we" in direct speech. This change reflects the speakers' perspective correctly.
 
• The original sentence is in reported speech, where the verb tense often shifts back. "would go" in reported speech corresponds to "will go" in direct speech because the original intention was about a plan or intention in the future. The shift from "would" to "will" accurately represents the future intention in the context of when the statement was made.
 
• The reported speech includes "the next day" to indicate when the action was planned to occur. In direct speech, this phrase is typically adjusted to reflect the time relative to the speakers' current moment, thus "the next day" turns into "tomorrow." This change is a common practice when converting from indirect to direct speech to maintain the time frame's accuracy from the speaker's point of view.

Hence, the correct answer is ‘**Option 1’.**
